_comment: Local Turnkey signer settings. DISABLED by default. Org id and key path here are not secrets (the key FILE is never in the repo). Credentials: env TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY/TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY (hex) or the PEM at api_key_path / env TURNKEY_API_KEY_PATH; env TURNKEY_ORG_ID overrides organization_id. per_trade and daily caps are enforced LOCALLY by tools/turnkey_signer.py; Turnkey policies (policies.json) enforce the per-transaction cap and program/destination allowlists server-side; Turnkey has no native daily/cumulative limit for signing. tools/turnkey_signer.py never reads `broadcast`; tools/turnkey_broadcast.py needs broadcast true AND --broadcast-confirm.
